name: slot
description: Run every build through the shared slot pool: skills for building, setup and upgrade, a PreToolUse hook that refuses builds outside the pool, and the slot-warden agent that finds sessions still building outside it.

interface.shortDescription: Share one pool of build slots across every agent session.
interface.longDescription: Prefix builds with the slot CLI so cargo, go, make, task and JavaScript test runs from every session draw from one GNU-make jobserver pool, queue instead of oversubscribing the machine, and show live in one web view; remote mode moves them to a build server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the slot building skill to run this build through the shared slot pool.
